description: Select an area by radius or regions, with optional map integration.

howToUse: Use it when people choose where a search applies: a radius around a point, or a list of neighborhoods.
Pass the regions in `neighborhoods` and the center in `baseId`. Limit the radius with `minRadius`, `maxRadius` and `radiusStep`.
The map is optional: pass your map provider in `map`. Without it, the choice works by text and the slider.
alternatives: A full address: PostalCodeInput and Input.
Picking a few cities from a list, without radius: Multiselect.

keyboard.action: Moves through the radius, the region search and the chosen regions.
Changes the radius by one step, as in Range.
Same as Multiselect: `↓` `↑` move, `Enter` adds or removes, `Escape` closes.

props.name: map
props.description: Map provider slot. The text selection still belongs to the DS.

examples.label: Local map
examples.description: Local synthetic map: arrows and Enter/Space select, no external service.

examples.label: Radius
examples.description: The radius redraws the map and immediately updates the neighborhoods reached.

examples.label: Excluded
